name: Way of the Long Death
summary: Monks obsessed with the mechanics of dying.

features.name: Touch of Death
features.short: Gain temp HP when you drop a creature to 0.
features.summary: When you reduce a creature within 5 ft. to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + monk level.

features.name: Hour of Reaping
features.short: Action: frighten every creature within 30 ft.
features.summary: As an action, each creature within 30 ft. that can see you makes a WIS save or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Mastery of Death
features.short: Spend 1 ki to drop to 1 HP instead of 0.
features.summary: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can spend 1 ki point to have 1 hit point instead.

features.name: Touch of the Long Death
features.short: Spend up to 10 ki for 2d10 necrotic per point.
features.summary: As an action, touch a creature and spend 1 to 10 ki points. It makes a CON save, taking 2d10 necrotic damage per ki point on a failure, half on a success.
